_about: Talking points the call briefing may offer the advisor, in priority order. 'when' names a condition computed in backend/callmode.py. Keep texts free of numbers, promises and forecasts; the claim rules in docs/PLAN.md apply.

angles.text: Acknowledge the concern first, then give the numbers.
Confirm the amount and the date of the cash need before discussing what to sell.
Start with what held up, then walk through what fell.
If they push back on the open rule, explain what it protects, not just that it applies.
Frame today against the long-term plan, not the daily move.
Advise against acting on a single day's move; offer to review the positions together.
Agree on a concrete next step and when you will call back.
